name: Photo + headline
description: Your photo behind a bold headline, a supporting line and a button. For a launch, a new service, an event or a seasonal message. Without a photo it shows your brand colours.

eyebrow.label: Label
eyebrow.description: A short label above the headline, e.g. NEW THIS AUTUMN. Leave empty for none.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The big statement. Use | to break the line, e.g. COLOUR|THAT LASTS.

headline_accent.label: Accent words
headline_accent.description: Words of the headline shown in your brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

subline.label: Supporting line
subline.description: One or two sentences under the headline. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Button
cta.description: The button's words, e.g. Book now. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: Your account handle, top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

photo.label: Photo
photo.description: The photo behind the words: a person, a place or a product, with no words in it. Upload one, pick one from the Library, or let AI make one. Without it, your brand colours show.

sample_data.headline: COLOUR|THAT LASTS.
sample_data.subline: Gloss treatments that keep your colour bright for weeks, not days.
